## Type of Change

Please mark the relevant option(s):

- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update, policy update, or README enhancement
- [ ] `feat`: New feature, category taxonomy addition, or catalog schema update
- [ ] `fix`: Correction of a catalog entry, broken link, or metadata bug
- [ ] `chore`: Repository maintenance, tooling, or dependency updates
- [ ] `ci`: GitHub Actions or automation workflow adjustments
- [ ] `test`: Validation rules, test fixtures, or schema checks
